character_spec.name: The Wanderer
character_spec.visual_identity: Minimalist dark comic stickman figure with oversized warm ivory oval head, two vertical black pill eyes, neutral slit mouth, thin black stick limbs and torso
character_spec.clothing: Brick-red ribbed knit beanie, thick warm knitted scarf with alternating horizontal mustard-yellow and rust-maroon stripes with fringe, dark charcoal short-sleeved t-shirt
character_spec.distinguishing_features: Warm cream oval head, brick-red folded-brim knit beanie, mustard-and-maroon striped scarf, solid black stick limbs, bold clean black outlines
character_spec.color_palette: Brick-red (#A03325), Warm ivory (#F9E8CE), Mustard gold (#DFA028), Rust maroon (#8C2B1D), Dark charcoal (#454242), Carbon black (#18181A)

illustration_rules.linework: Clean, bold, uniform black outlines, closed vector contour styling
illustration_rules.shading: Subtle cel-shading with soft directional under-brim and under-scarf shadow
illustration_rules.texture: Knitted ribbing on beanie brim and scarf, flat smooth fills on skin and shirt

prompt_injection.character_anchor: The Wanderer, an original 2D dark comic stickman protagonist. Smooth warm ivory oval head, two small vertical black pill-shaped eyes, simple slit mouth. Wearing a distinctive chunky brick-red ribbed knit beanie, a thick winter scarf with alternating mustard-gold and rust-maroon horizontal stripes and fringe, and a dark charcoal short-sleeved t-shirt over thin black stick arms and legs.
prompt_injection.style_anchor: Cinematic 2D graphic-novel dark comic illustration, animated storybook thriller style. Crisp bold black outlines, clean cel-shaded fills, rich directional lighting, edge-to-edge full canvas illustration, completely borderless.
prompt_injection.strict_negative: Absolutely NO white borders, NO decorative frames, NO black letterbox bars, NO split-screen panels, NO comic speech bubbles, NO text captions, NO 3D photorealism, NO plain white hairless un-beanie figures.
